rationale: Discharge-only battery plan maximizing net discharge within SOC and power limits. Usable SOC of 2.5 MWh at 0.9 discharge efficiency caps net discharge at 27 MW (26 MW in 2 MW steps); per-period discharge also capped so diesel stays at/above pmin=12. Diesel+PV+battery exactly serves load in every interval with no curtailment or shedding. Total diesel = 93 MW, cost = 93*0.0833333*92 = 713.0.
